brief: Indian shares are rallying strongly, with Sensex up about 1,300 to 1,500 points intraday and about Rs 2.2 lakh crore of wealth added as Infosys, TCS and HDFC Bank gain. Foreign inflows and lower oil prices are helping, even though US markets slid and the Nvidia rally fizzled.
